cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you go, check that window latch. I taught you to leave a room secure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nearly finished. What did I teach you about checking the whole room? That curtain's moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the fan, not the window. I'll switch it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you found the cause. Before you switch it off, tell me how you knew. I never taught you to guess at electrics.
